We are very happy to announce that SPUDM29 will take place in Vienna, Austria between August 20th-24th, 2023 as the <a href="https://www.wu.ac.at">Vienna University of Economics and Business</a>.

We thank <a href="https://www.wu.ac.at/en/cobe/team/prof-dr-susann-fiedler/">Susann Fiedler</a> for taking on the burden of organising the conference.

<a href="https://www.wien.info/en">Vienna</a> is an awesome destination that everybody should at least visit once in a lifetime - so here is your chance!

Save the date!
